name: ZenHub Sprint → Notion Board Sync
description: Sync ZenHub sprint issues and pipeline changes to a Notion database for cross-team visibility.

nodes.notes: Polls every 15 minutes. ZenHub has webhooks too — swap for webhook trigger if preferred.
Fetches current ZenHub board state. Requires ZENHUB_API_TOKEN env var.
Flattens the board into individual issues with pipeline status.
Upserts each issue into the Notion sprint database. Create a Notion DB with columns: Issue Number (number), Pipeline (select), Estimate (number), Is Epic (checkbox).
